T3_about.h2: What VARIANT II TURBO is and who it is for
T3_about.text: VARIANT II TURBO is an automated Bio-Rad system for HbA1c measurement by ion-exchange high-performance liquid chromatography. It is intended for laboratories with high HbA1c testing workloads. The loader supports large runs, while the time to result helps teams anticipate the progress of each sample.

items.text: The system accepts whole blood in primary tubes, reducing manual preparation before analysis. A laboratory can use continuous or batch loading to match its workflow.
Bio-Rad Clinical Data Management software stores chromatograms and results. According to the manufacturer, it can also interface with a laboratory information system.
According to the manufacturer, the system produces up to 216 results in 8 hours and up to 648 results in 24 hours. This provides a practical basis for planning large HbA1c runs.
